answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 8472 Country: India Title: Could you pls explain the meaning of Markrooh? Can my wife call me by my name? Question: Could you pls explain the meaning of Markrooh? Can my wife call me by my name? Answer ID: 8472 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1881/1760=D/1429) Makrooh (undesirable) is the antonym of Mahboob (desirable). An action undesirable in the eye of Shariah is called makrooh . If the undesirability is of higher degree e.g. it deserves punishment by Hadith then it is Makrooh Tahrimi (undesirable to an extent of being haram ), otherwise Makrooh Tanzihi which means: not better to do. As per the Shariah, it is makrooh to call husband with his name: قال ف ي الدر: ویکرہ أن یدعو الرجل أباہ و أن تدعو المراۃ زوجھا بإسمھا ( شامي 5:298 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
